transport.rust_route: bounded JSON POST; server/discover, tools/list, tools/call

credential_path: synthetic subject authentication/workload issuance -> successful etcd claim -> real mTLS RFC8693 broker -> synthetic target token -> real mTLS fixed mock endpoint; caller token never forwarded to target; no target token in gateway replies
local_bypass_coverage: mTLS caller with absent/caller token gets HTTP401; absent mTLS certificate fails; same-process fixture knows target token; OS isolation and full writer inventory untested
mock_target: mutex atomically checks resource/version and increasing fence, then advances version and commit counter; optional HTTP503 after commit
grant_lifecycle: single resource, one root, one active generation; replace only unclaimed; issue/claim/replace share atomic etcd domain; claim consumption retained for all four terminal outcomes
dispatch_authority_linearization: policy/ownership checked atomically at authorize_dispatch; later revocation cannot recall an authorized in-flight request
completion_persistence_limit: failed or ambiguous finish can leave claimed state; reconcile accepts only persisted unknown; stranded-claimed recovery unimplemented; consumption retained
reconciliation: library only; query correlated attempt/root/grant_digest/nonempty target_reference; only committed observation transitions unknown; other status retains unknown; no query HTTP service or real target status integration
